full_judgment: 5. It has been stated in the application that Part V of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 which includes section 96 of the Act came into operation on the 1st August, 1963 in the District of Rajshahi wherein the land under. Pre-emption lies. The right of pre-emption accrued in the present case on the 14th November, 1960, the date of the Kabala under pre-emption, when Section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act was not brought into operation but section 26F of the Bengal Tenancy Act was in force. In the circumstances the learned Advocate for the petitioner has submitted that the application for pre-emption should be deemed to be an application under, section 26F of the Bengal Tenancy Act, although the same has been purported to have been filed under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
